                 cs_item_sk item_sk,                  cs_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   catalog_sales           union all           select ws_sold_date_sk sold_date_sk,                  ws_bill_customer_sk customer_sk,                  ws_item_sk item_sk,                  ws_wholesale_cost wholesale_cost           from   web_sales          ) cs_or_ws_sales,          item,          date_dim,          customer  where   sold_date_sk = d_date_sk          and item_sk = i_item_sk          and i_category = 'Electronics'          and i_class = 'portable'          and c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk          and d_moy = 6          and d_year = 2002          and wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100          and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991  )  , my_revenue as (  select c_customer_sk,         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue  from   my_customers,         store_sales,         customer_address,         store,         date_dim  where  c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk         and ca_county = s_county         and ca_state = s_state         and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk         and c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk         and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100         and s_state in ('AL','AR','FL'                     ,'MN','MO','NC'                     ,'NY','OK','PA'                     ,'WI')         and d_month_seq between (select distinct d_month_seq+1                                  from   date_dim where d_year = 2002 and d_moy = 6)                            and  (select distinct d_month_seq+3                                  from rewritten_query:
with all_sales as (
    select cs_sold_date_sk as sold_date_sk,
           cs_bill_customer_sk as customer_sk,
           cs_item_sk as item_sk,
           cs_wholesale_cost as wholesale_cost
    from catalog_sales
    union all
    select ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws_bill_customer_sk,
           ws_item_sk,
           ws_wholesale_cost
    from web_sales
),
qualifying_customers as (
    select distinct s.customer_sk
    from all_sales s
    join item i on i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk
    join date_dim d on d.d_date_sk = s.sold_date_sk
    where i.i_category = 'Electronics'
      and i.i_class = 'portable'
      and d.d_year = 2002
      and d.d_moy = 6
      and s.wholesale_cost between 70 and 100
),
my_customers as (
    select c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk
    from customer c
    join qualifying_customers qc on qc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    where c.c_birth_year between 1978 and 1991
),
my_revenue as (
    select c.c_customer_sk,
           sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue
    from my_customers c
    join store_sales ss on ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    join customer_address ca on ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    join store s on s.s_county = ca.ca_county and s.s_state = ca.ca_state
    join date_dim d on d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    where ss.ss_wholesale_cost between 70 and 100
      and s.s_state in ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')
      and ca.ca_state in ('AL','AR','FL','MN','MO','NC','NY','OK','PA','WI')
      and d.d_year = 2002
      and d.d_moy between 7 and 9
    group by c.c_customer_sk
),
segments as (
    select cast(revenue / 50 as int) as segment
    from my_revenue
)
select segment,
       count(*) as num_customers,
       segment * 50 as segment_base
from segments
group by segment
order by segment, num_customers
limit 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the two scalar subqueries computing d_month_seq+1 and d_month_seq+3 from June 2002 with the literal equivalent: d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 9. Since d_month_seq is monotonically increasing per calendar month, the range June_month_seq+1..+3 is exactly July-September 2002, eliminating two date_dim scans (InitPlans).

Deduplicate customer_sk early (before joining customer). Since c_current_addr_sk is functionally dependent on c_customer_sk, DISTINCT on both columns is equivalent to DISTINCT on customer_sk. Keep the UNION ALL of catalog_sales/web_sales before joining item and date_dim so the item and date joins are shared once (the previous rewrite pushed them into each UNION branch, causing regression), then join customer afterward to avoid sorting extra columns.

Add the redundant-but-helpful predicate ca.ca_state IN (...) on customer_address. It is implied by ca_state = s_state AND s_state IN (...), but making it explicit enables early filtering of customer_address before the county/state join with store.

Convert implicit comma joins to explicit JOIN syntax for better readability and clearer join-order hints to the optimizer; keep the aggregation pipeline (my_revenue -> segments -> final group by) unchanged as it is already minimal.
